newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaragua denies offering Peru rebels asylum.
newsitem.headline: Nicaragua denies offering Peru rebels asylum.

text.p: Nicaragua on Thursday denied Peruvian television reports that it had offered asylum to Marxist rebels holding 72 hostages in the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima.
"The Foreign Ministry has no knowledge of where this information came from and has no knowledge of such an offer," spokesman David Silva told Reuters.

Citing unnamed sources, Peruvian television stations on Thursday said Nicaragua was offering political asylum to the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebels, who have held their captives for 51 days.
Silva said any such offer from Nicaragua would have to come through the foreign ministry.
The rebels say they do not want to leave Peru but want their imprisoned comrades to be freed and to be allowed to return to their jungle base in Peru's Upper Huallaga Valley.
